body.p: A number of people lived at Isortuaqdjuin, in Kingawa. One day in spring Kooban was out looking for young seals, and when near the water-hole at Echayaling, he saw a number of killer-whales which had kept a place open during the winter. Their back-fins were covered with ice, and they were very thin and weak. Kooban went home and told the other people what he had seen. On the following day they all went to see the killer-whales. They discussed how they {273} could best kill them. They took their kayak spears and harpooned them; but they did not cut them up, because they thought they would not have enough blubber, and that their meat would be too rank.
